title: Rams C Coleman Shelton to miss 4-6 weeks with a hamstring injury

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Rams C Coleman Shelton to miss 4-6 weeks with a hamstring injury
sources.description: The Rams are on their bye this week and that gives them some extra time to figure out how to address the center position before their return to action against the Packers in Week 12.
